prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
ai_overview_text:
Top-rated independent health insurance brokers and agencies in the Kansas City metro area offer zero-cost guidance (paid directly by insurance carriers) to help you compare individual, family, Marketplace (ACA), and Medicare plans:
Services: Individual and family Marketplace/private plans (with subsidy checks), small group health (2–50 teams with Aetna and UnitedHealthcare), Medicare (Parts A–D, Advantage, and Medigap), life, and supplemental insurance.
Locations: North Kansas City, MO (1327 Burlington St), Lawson, MO, and Overland Park, KS.
Contact & Rating: (816) 205-4664; BBB A+ accredited with a 5.0 Google rating. BBS Insurance Inc.
Services: Independent, fee-free guidance for Medicare (Advantage, Supplement, Part D), ACA Marketplace individual and family health insurance, and small business group plans.
Coverage Area: Based in Overland Park, KS, serving the entire Kansas City metro (including Leawood, Lenexa, Olathe, Independence, and Lee's Summit).
Carriers Compared: Cigna, Aetna, Kaiser, and Allstate. AIS Health Insurance Advisors
Services: Individual, family, and small business health insurance brokerage with no hidden fees or extra cost compared to the public Marketplace.
Contact: (913) 341-9393 ext. 2 or shawn.moulin@benefitserviceskc.com. www.health-insurance-kansas-city.com
Services: Medicare enrollment, Marketplace guidance, dental, life, and travel insurance.
Contact & Credentials: Operating since 1993; licensed agent at (816) 436-2622; Marketplace Elite Circle of Champions and Aetna Frontrunner. Jeff David Insurance
Cost: Using an independent health insurance broker is free to you. Brokers are compensated directly by insurance companies, and your plan rates do not change whether you enroll directly or through a broker. www.health-insurance-kansas-city.com +2
Subsidies & Paperwork: They handle application paperwork, help determine if you qualify for monthly Affordable Care Act (ACA) premium tax credits or cost-sharing reductions, and review whether your preferred doctors and prescriptions are in-network. AIS Health Insurance Advisors +1
